label: levetiracetam 2000 mg oral solution, fasted, n=16 men, serum
note: Ruijs TQ et al. Br J Clin Pharmacol 2022;88(6):2926-2937, supporting information Table S1 (BCP-88-2926-s003.docx; PMC9303426). Single 2000 mg dose of generic oral solution (100 mg/mL), above the usual single dose but within the label's linear range (500-5000 mg). Sparse: 6 post-dose samples at the printed clock times; the first (0.5 h) is already the median Tmax, so absorption is not resolved. 17 healthy men enrolled (75 kg), 16 completed; the table does not state its n. HPLC-DAD, LLOQ 2.5 ug/mL.
